title: Widget mode elicit: managed, non-interactive, invisible per Cloudflare Turnstile documented modes; recommendedDefault managed
description: The applying operator elicits one of Cloudflare Turnstile documented widget modes: managed (default; challenge shown only when Cloudflare deems it necessary), non-interactive (always shows a non-interactive challenge) or invisible (mounts an invisible widget). The default mode is managed per ADR-3602.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-turnstile.
